group_name: Tool capability: frames from real references
title: Roosevelt's head on his body

turns.text: Put Theodore Roosevelt's head (first photo) on this man's body (second photo): same blue T-shirt, same crossed arms, same wall, same colour photo. Just the head changes.

tests: A head swap (hair and all), old black-and-white head onto a colour body: swap_head_in_photo or an edit?

answer_sheet.Onto: The man in the second photo.
answer_sheet.Keep: The T-shirt, the arms, the wall, the colour.

must_haves: The head is Roosevelt's: the pince-nez glasses, the thick moustache, the side-parted hair.
The body, blue T-shirt, crossed arms and the brick wall are the second photo's.
The head is in colour and lit like the rest of the photo, not pasted in grey.
The framing matches the second photo.
